name: Takatoo Tokio
source:
"Come on. It'll be better than going to class. Most likely, anyway."

A 17-year-old high schooler in Class 2-C.

A student with keen intelligence who has the best grades in the colony. He uses one of the rooms at school to conduct his own research, which he prioritizes above all else. He's often seen sleeping in class.

His childhood best friend is the student council president, Ayumu Mamiya, who frequently looks out for him.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
